name: [Part 1] overlapping phrases form one highlighted block
input: document = 'A red bird sings at dawn.'; sources = ['red bird', 'bird sings']
test:
result = highlight_with_citations('A red bird sings at dawn.', ['red bird', 'bird sings'])
assert result.tagged_document == 'A <yellow>red bird sings</yellow>[0][1] at dawn.'
assert result.counts == {0: 1, 1: 1}
assert result.citations == [[0, 1]]

name: [Part 1] whitespace-adjacent matches merge without losing spacing
test:
result = highlight_with_citations('alpha  beta, gamma', ['alpha', 'beta', 'gamma'])
assert result.tagged_document == '<yellow>alpha  beta</yellow>[0][1], <yellow>gamma</yellow>[2]'
assert result.counts == {0: 1, 1: 1, 2: 1}
assert result.citations == [[0, 1], [2]]

name: [Part 2] global frequency orders citations and duplicate sources stay distinct
input: document = 'A red bird sings while a red fish swims.'; sources = ['red bird', 'bird sings', 'red', 'fish']
test:
result = highlight_with_citations('A red bird sings while a red fish swims.', ['red bird', 'bird sings', 'red', 'fish'])
assert result.tagged_document == 'A <yellow>red bird sings</yellow>[2][0][1] while a <yellow>red fish</yellow>[2][3] swims.'
assert result.counts == {0: 1, 1: 1, 2: 2, 3: 1}
assert result.citations == [[2, 0, 1], [2, 3]]

duplicates = highlight_with_citations('red red', ['red', 'red'])
assert duplicates.tagged_document == '<yellow>red red</yellow>[0][1]'
assert duplicates.counts == {0: 2, 1: 2}
assert duplicates.citations == [[0, 1]]

name: word boundaries are case-sensitive and do not match inside a token
test:
result = highlight_with_citations('sunshine sun Sun sun', ['sun', 'Sun', 'sun'])
assert result.tagged_document == 'sunshine <yellow>sun Sun sun</yellow>[0][2][1]'
assert result.counts == {0: 2, 1: 1, 2: 2}
assert result.citations == [[0, 2, 1]]

name: no valid occurrence preserves the original document
test:
result = highlight_with_citations('unrelated_text', ['related', 'text'])
assert result.tagged_document == 'unrelated_text'
assert result.counts == {0: 0, 1: 0}
assert result.citations == []
